title: idpf-implementer result
description: The JSON result one idpf-implementer instance returns for its member issue (#3499, PRD #3493). The parent validates it with .claude/scripts/shared/lib/subagent-result.js before it enters the Merge-Back Review Gate or a member report; a result failing validation, an empty reply or an errored Agent call is that instance's error, never a guessed outcome. Role contract: Reference/Agent-Architecture.md.

issue.description: The member issue this instance implemented.

commits.description: The Refs #N commits the instance made in its worktree, oldest first. Empty when it committed nothing — the parent's Tier 1 check then reports it.

acVerification.description: One entry per acceptance criterion: whether the instance verified it against the files, with the evidence. Every criterion carries exactly one status (rule 01, Claim Labeling).

unfinished.description: Work the instance did not finish, each item stated so the parent can report it. An empty array is the claim that nothing was left.

docJudgment.description: The /work Step 3b line, verbatim as it would be written into the issue body: `**Doc judgment:** none — <reason>` or `**Doc judgment:** <path>`.
